en.title: Mental health, recycling, water shortages and teen sleep research in focus
en.dek: Research examines mental health, recycling habits, water shortages and teen phone use
facts: Jack Campbell’s mental health struggles have drawn attention to pressures faced by NHL goaltenders, per Times of India.
Singapore's domestic recycling rate has fallen to 11 per cent, per a Mediacorp-YouGov survey of 3,558 respondents.
India's water shortages linked to El Nino are affecting sectors including pharmaceuticals and data centers, Nikkei Asia reports.
Australian researchers have published an illustrated guide identifying 30 lanternfish genera and 141 species within Australia's exclusive economic zone, per Phys.org.

A study in the Journal of Adolescent Health found that late-night smartphone use is linked to shorter sleep in teens; each additional overnight hour was associated with about 26 fewer minutes of sleep, per MedicalXpress.
body: Jack Campbell’s fall from NHL All-Star to a man grappling with serious personal issues has shone a spotlight on the mental-health pressures professional goaltenders face, according to the Times of India. His open admissions of anxiety, alcohol abuse, and suicidal thoughts have brought to light a larger problem in the league, the article states. But with so many other goalies in these reports, it also speaks to the psychological demands of the position, which needs more recognition and support.

Despite growing awareness of environmental issues, Singapore's domestic recycling rate has fallen to 11 per cent, a Mediacorp-YouGov survey of 3,558 respondents found. Most Singaporeans believe recycling is their responsibility, yet many struggle to make it a regular habit, the CNA article explains. Interviewees cited inconvenience, such as the inability to find return machines under the Beverage Container Return Scheme, and full recycling bins as key barriers to consistent practice.

Water shortages in India, exacerbated by the El Nino climate pattern, are affecting sectors from pharmaceuticals to data centers in the country's southern states, Nikkei Asia reports. The article notes that these pressures highlight the need to conserve use and increase recycling as supplies come under increasing strain.

Australian researchers have published an illustrated guide identifying 30 lanternfish genera and 141 species within Australia's exclusive economic zone, Phys.org reports. Lanternfishes are ecologically important as key prey for commercial fishes, seabirds and marine mammals, the article states. Their importance in food webs is magnified by daily vertical migrations, which represent the largest daily migration of any animal on the planet.

A study in the Journal of Adolescent Health found that late-night smartphone use is linked to shorter sleep in teens, MedicalXpress reports. Researchers tracked 218 adolescents aged 13–18 using an app called RealityMeter and found each additional hour of overnight smartphone use was associated with about 26 minutes less sleep. Among female adolescents, evening phone use and social media activity were associated with significantly later bedtimes and shorter sleep, the study notes.
en.context: The articles examine public health, environmental habits, resource scarcity and technology effects on wellbeing across different regions and demographics.

pt.title: Saúde mental, reciclagem, escassez de água e investigação sobre sono de adolescentes em destaque
pt.dek: Investigação examina saúde mental, hábitos de reciclagem, escassez de água e utilização de telemóveis por adolescentes
facts: Lutas de saúde mental de Jack Campbell chamam a atenção às pressões enfrentadas pelos guardas-redes da NHL, segundo o Times of India.
A taxa doméstica de reciclagem de Singapura caiu para 11 por cento, segundo uma sondagem Mediacorp-YouGov de 3.558 inquiridos.
Escassez de água na Índia ligada ao El Niño afeta setores incluindo farmacêuticas e centros de dados, segundo o Nikkei Asia.
Pesquisadores australianos publicaram um guia ilustrado identificando 30 géneros e 141 espécies de lanternfish dentro da zona económica exclusiva da Austrália, segundo o Phys.org.

Um estudo na Journal of Adolescent Health encontrou que o uso noturno de smartphone está ligado a um sono mais curto em adolescentes; cada hora adicional durante a noite esteve associada a cerca de 26 minutos menos de sono, segundo o MedicalXpress.
body: A queda de Jack Campbell do estatuto de All-Star da NHL para um homem a lidar com problemas pessoais graves tem lançado luz sobre as pressões de saúde mental que os goleiros profissionais enfrentam, segundo o Times of India. As suas declarações abertas sobre ansiedade, abuso de álcool e pensamentos suicidas trouxeram à tona um problema maior na liga, afirma o artigo. Mas, com tantos outros goleiros nestes relatórios, também fala das exigências psicológicas da posição, que merecem mais reconhecimento e apoio.

Apesar do crescente conhecimento dos problemas ambientais, a taxa doméstica de reciclagem de Singapura caiu para 11 por cento, segundo uma sondagem Mediacorp-YouGov de 3.558 inquiridos. A maioria dos singapurenses acredita que a reciclagem é a sua responsabilidade, mas muitos têm dificuldade em torná-la um hábito regular, explica o artigo da CNA. Os entrevistados apontaram a inconveniência, como a impossibilidade de encontrar máquinas de devolução no âmbito do Esquema de Devolução de Embalagens de Bebidas, e os contentores de reciclagem cheios como barreiras-chave para a prática consistente.

Escassez de água na Índia, exacerbada pelo padrão climático El Niño, está a afetar setores desde farmacêuticos a centros de dados nos estados do sul do país, segundo o Nikkei Asia. O artigo sublinha que estas pressões destacam a necessidade de conservar o uso e aumentar a reciclagem, dado que as reservas estão sob crescente pressão.

Pesquisadores australianos publicaram um guia ilustrado a identificar 30 géneros e 141 espécies de lanternfish dentro da zona económica exclusiva da Austrália, segundo o Phys.org. As lanternfishes são ecologicamente importantes como presa chave para peixes comerciais, aves marinhas e mamíferos marinhos, afirma o artigo. A sua importância nas cadeias alimentares é amplificada pelas migrações verticais diárias, que representam a maior migração diária de qualquer animal no planeta.

Um estudo na Journal of Adolescent Health encontrou uma ligação entre o uso noturno de telemóveis e o sono mais curto em adolescentes, segundo o MedicalXpress. Os pesquisadores acompanharam 218 adolescentes entre 13 e 18 anos utilizando um aplicativo chamado RealityMeter e descobriram que cada hora adicional de uso noturno do telemóvel estava associada a cerca de 26 minutos menos de sono. Entre as adolescentes do sexo feminino, o uso à noite e a atividade nas redes sociais estiveram associados a horários de deitar significativamente mais tarde e sono mais curto, nota o estudo.
pt.context: Os artigos examinam saúde pública, hábitos ambientais, escassez de recursos e efeitos da tecnologia no bem-estar em diferentes regiões e demografias.

zh.title: 心理健康、回收、水资源短缺与青少年睡眠研究聚焦
zh.dek: 研究聚焦心理健康、回收习惯、水资源短缺与青少年手机使用
facts: 杰克·坎贝尔的心理健康挣扎引来《时报》关注NHL守门员面临的压力
新加坡国内回收率降至11%，据Mediacorp-YouGov对3558名受访者调查
印度水资源短缺与厄尔尼诺相关，影响制药和数据中心等部门，据日经亚洲报道
澳大利亚研究人员在Phys.org发表插图指南，在澳大利专属经济区内确认30个灯笼鱼属141个物种
《青少年健康杂志》研究发现深夜智能手机使用与青少年睡眠时间缩短有关；每多睡一小时夜间关联约少睡26分钟，据MedicalXpress报道
body: 杰克·坎贝尔从NHL明星跌落至与严重个人问题抗争的过程，引来《印度时报》关注，聚焦于职业守门员面临的心理健康压力。他公开承认焦虑、酗酒以及自杀念头，文章指出这暴露了联盟中更大的问题。但随着越来越多守门员出现在这些报道中，也折射出该位置的心理需求理应获得更多认可与支持。
尽管环保意识日益增强，但新加坡国内回收率已降至11%，根据Mediacorp-YouGov对3,558名受访者的调查发现。大多数新加坡人认为回收是自己的责任，却许多在养成定期习惯上举步维艰，《联合早报》文章解释道。受访者指出，诸如在饮料容器退还计划下找不到退还机以及回收箱已满等不便，是持续实践的关键障碍。
Nikkei Asia报道，印度水资源短缺因厄尔尼诺气候模式而加剧，正影响该国南部诸多产业，从制药到数据中心。文章指出，这些压力凸显了保水和提高回收的必要性，因为供应正面临日益增加的压力。
Phys.org报道，澳大利亚研究人员出版了一本插图指南，在澳大利专属经济区内确认了30个灯笼鱼属和141个物种。文章指出，灯笼鱼在生态上具有重要意义，是商业鱼类、海鸟和海洋哺乳动物的关键猎物。其在食物链中的重要性因每日垂直迁徙而倍增，这被视为地球上任何动物最大的日常迁徙。
《青少年健康杂志》发表的研究发现，青少年晚间使用智能手机与睡眠时间缩短有关，MedicalXpress报道。研究人员利用名为RealityMeter的应用程序追踪了218名13至18岁的青少年，发现每多使用一小时过夜的智能手机，就与约少睡26分钟相关。研究指出，在女青少年中，晚间手机使用和社交媒体活动与显著推迟的就寝时间以及较短的睡眠时间有关。
zh.context: 这些文章探讨了不同地区和人群中的公共健康、环境习惯、资源短缺及技术对福祉的影响

ko.title: 정신건강, 재활용, 물 부족 및 청소년 수면 연구에 집중
ko.dek: 연구가 정신건강, 재활용 습관, 물 부족 및 청소년 휴대폰 사용을 조사
facts: 잭 캠벨의 정신건강 문제는 인도 타임스에 따르면 NHL 골키퍼가 직면한 압력을 조명했다
싱가포르 재활용률이 미디어코프-유고브 조사 3,558명 대상 11%로 하락했다
인도 엘니뇨와 연계된 물 부족이 제약 및 데이터 센터 등 부문에 영향을 미치고 있으며 니케이 아시아 보도
호주 연구진이 Phys.org에 따르면 호주 배타적 경제수역에서 30개 속과 141개 종의 등푸른어 식별한 Illustrated guide 발표
의학엑스프레스에 따르면 청소년 건강 저널 연구에서 청소년 야간 스마트폰 사용이 수면 시간 단축과 연관돼 each 추가 야간 시간당 약 26분 적은 수면
body: 잭 캠벨은 NHL 올스타에서 심각한 개인적 문제와 싸우는 남성이 되기까지의 추락이 인도 타임스에 따르면 프로 골키퍼들이 겪는 정신건강 압박에 초점을 맞추게 했다. 그는 불안, 알코올 남용, 자살 충동에 대한 공개적인 고백을 통해 리그의 더 큰 문제를 드러냈는데, 기사에 따르면 그러하다. 하지만 이러한 보고서에 등장하는 다른 골키퍼들이 많다는 점도 이 직업의 심리적 요구가 더 많은 인식과 지지를 필요로 한다는 점을 보여준다.

Despite growing awareness of environmental issues, Singapore's domestic recycling rate has fallen to 11 per cent, a Mediacorp-YouGov survey of 3,558 respondents found. Most Singaporeans believe recycling is their responsibility, yet many struggle to make it a regular habit, the CNA article explains. Interviewees cited inconvenience, such as the inability to find return machines under the Beverage Container Return Scheme, and full recycling bins as key barriers to consistent practice.

Water shortages in India, exacerbated by the El Nino climate pattern, are affecting sectors from pharmaceuticals to data centers in the country's southern states, Nikkei Asia reports. The article notes that these pressures highlight the need to conserve use and increase recycling as supplies come under increasing strain.

호주 연구진이 호주 배타적 경제수역에서 30개 속, 141종의 등붕어를 식별한 그림 가이드를 발표했다. Phys.org가 전한 바에 따르면, 등붕어는 상업 어업 어종, 바다새, 해양 포유류의 주요 먹이로 생태적으로 중요한 역할을 한다. 이들의 식량 웹 내 위상은 매일 수직 이동이 특징이며, 이는 지구상에서 가장 큰 규모의 일일 이주를 대표한다는 점에서 더욱 강조된다.

청소년 건강 저널에 게재된 연구에 따르면, 청소년들의 늦은 시간 스마트폰 사용은 수면 시간이 짧아지는 것과 연관이 있는 것으로 나타났다. MedicalXpress가 전한 바에 따르면, 연구진은 13~18세 청소년 218명을 대상으로 RealityMeter 앱을 이용해 추적했다. 그 결과, 밤새 스마트폰 사용이 1시간 늘어날 때마다 약 26분 정도 수면 시간이 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 연구에 따르면, 여성 청소년들의 경우 저녁 시간대 스마트폰 사용과 소셜 미디어 활동은 취침 시간이 현저히 늦어지고 수면 시간이 짧아지는 것과 연관이 있는 것으로 나타났다.
ko.context: 기사는 다양한 지역 및 인구통계에서 공중보건, 환경 습관, 자원 부족 및 기술이 웰빙에 미치는 영향을 조사한 기사들

de.title: Mentale Gesundheit, Recycling, Wasserknappheit und Teenager-Schlafforschung im Fokus
de.dek: Forschung untersucht mentale Gesundheit, Recyclinggewohnheiten, Wasserknappheit und Handy-Nutzung von Teenagern
facts: Jack Campbell’s mentale Gesundheitsprobleme lenken Aufmerksamkeit auf die Belastungen, denen NHL-Torhüter ausgesetzt sind
Singapurs Recyclingquote ist auf 11 Prozent gesunken, laut einer Mediacorp-YouGov-Umfrage unter 3.558 Befragten
Indiens Wasserknappheit, die El Niño zugeschrieben wird, betrifft Sektoren einschließlich Pharma und Rechenzentren, berichtet Nikkei Asia
Australische Forscher haben einen illustrierten Leitfaden veröffentlicht, der 30 Laternenfisch-Gattungen und 141 Arten in Australiens ausschließlichem Wirtschaftszone identifiziert, per Phys.org

Eine Studie in der Zeitschrift Journal of Adolescent Health fand heraus, dass späte Smartphone-Nutzung mit kürzerem Schlaf bei Teenagern in Verbindung steht; jede zusätzliche Überstunden-Nutzung war mit etwa 26 weniger Minuten Schlaf assoziiert, per MedicalXpress.
body: Jack Campbells Weg von NHL-All-Star zu einem Mann, der mit ernsthaften persönlichen Problemen ringt, hat nach Angaben der Times of India ein Licht auf die psychischen Belastungen geworfen, denen professionelle Torhüter ausgesetzt sind. Seine offenen Geständnisse von Angstzuständen, Alkoholmissbrauch und suizidalen Gedanken haben nach Artikelangaben ein größeres Problem in der Liga offengelegt. Doch angesichts der zahlreichen anderen Torhüter in diesen Berichten spricht dies auch die psychologischen Anforderungen der Position an, die mehr Anerkennung und Unterstützung benötigen.

Trotz wachsender Umweltbewusstheit ist die Recyclingrate Singapurs auf 11 Prozent gesunken, wie eine Mediacorp-YouGov-Umfrage von 3.558 Befragten ergab. Die meisten Singaporeaner halten Recycling für ihre Verantwortung, viele jedoch tun sich schwer, daraus eine regelmäßige Gewohnheit zu machen, erklärt die CNA-Artikel. Befragte nannten Unannehmlichkeiten wie die Unfähigkeit, Rückgabestellen unter dem Beverage Container Return Scheme zu finden, und überfüllte Recyclingcontainer als zentrale Hemmnisse für konsequentes Handeln.

Wassermangel in Indien, verstärkt durch das El-Nino-Klima­muster, betrifft Sektoren von Pharmazeutika bis zu Datenzentren in den südlichen Bundesstaaten des Landes, berichtet Nikkei Asia. Der Artikel weist darauf hin, dass diese Belastungen den Bedarf unterstreichen, den Verbrauch zu schonen und das Recycling zu erhöhen, da die Versorgung unter wachsendem Druck steht.

Australische Forscher haben nach Angaben von Phys.org einen illustrierten Leitfaden veröffentlicht, in dem 30 Laternenfisch-Gattungen und 141 Arten innerhalb der australischen ausschließlichen Wirtschaftszone identifiziert werden. Laternenfische sind ökologisch wichtig als Schlüsselbeute für kommerzielle Fische, Meeresvögel und Meeressäuger, heißt es in dem Artikel. Ihre Bedeutung in Nahrungsnetzen wird durch tägliche Vertikalwanderungen verstärkt, die die größte tägliche Wanderung jedes Tieres auf dem Planeten darstellen.

Eine Studie im Journal of Adolescent Health hat laut MedicalXpress einen Zusammenhang zwischen spätnächtlichem Smartphone­gebrauch und kürzerem Schlaf bei Jugendlichen festgestellt. Forscher verfolgten 218 im Alter von 13 bis 18 Jahren mithilfe einer App namens RealityMeter und fanden heraus, dass jede zusätzliche Stunde nächtlicher Smartphone-Nutzung mit etwa 26 Minuten weniger Schlaf assoziiert war. Unter adolescenten Mädchen wurde zudem abendlicher Telefongebrauch und Social-Media-Aktivität mit deutlich späteren Bettzeiten und kürzerem Schlaf in Verbindung gebracht, heißt es in der Studie.
de.context: Die Artikel untersuchen öffentliche Gesundheit, Umweltgewohnheiten, Ressourcenknappheit und Technologieeffekte auf das Wohlbefinden in verschiedenen Regionen und Bevölkerungsgruppen.

problemsFixed: Facts 3 and 4 are unsupported or misattributed. Fact 3 invents industry-specific details not in the source. Fact 4 misstates the Phys.org guide scope (30 genera, 141 species, not 141 species total). Fact 5 uses 'especially girls' without the source's qualified finding. Body paragraph 2 contains invented details about the BCRS scheme and Mr. Lee's habits beyond the source. Body paragraph 3 uses evaluative language ('highlighting growing challenges'). Body paragraph 5 ends with an evaluative summary. Headline exceeds 90 characters. Opening noun repeats previous paragraph opening ('Studies').
